verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a public API that covers its core objects, including refunds, disputes and Checkout Sessions. The docs describe safe-retry idempotency keys, backward-compatible monthly versioning, and API-key auth with least-privilege restricted keys, and OpenAPI spec files are published for SDK generation. A hands-on community report calls it 'the best API I've ever used' with clear documentation, and probes confirm agent-readable llms.txt and Markdown docs. Missing for 10: the OpenAPI spec is not served at standard discoverable docs paths (all probed paths returned 404; it is only in the GitHub repo), and no top-level API reference index appears in the pack.
